entries.german:
Kraft von Harrach vermacht seinem Vetter Hansen von Harrach mehrere Güter, Lehen der Herren von Rosenberg, in der Reichenthaler Pfarre.

Siegel: drei Siegel.
entries.english:
Kraft von Harrach bequeaths to his cousin Hansen von Harrach several properties, fiefs of the Lords of Rosenberg, in the Reichental parish.

Seal: three seals.

facts.subject: the lords von Rosenberg
facts.content: were the feudal lords of properties in the Reichental parish bequeathed by Kraft von Harrach to Hans von Harrach.
